title: appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Pseudocode produces out-of-range channel numbers
description: Lines 84-86 define N = MAX(NChannels, 3) and return 1 + (Hash MOD N). With NChannels=8 (channels 0-7), this can return channel 8 which doesn't exist. The note on lines 126-129 acknowledges implementations use NChannels-1, and the Python reference on lines 305-307 uses n = max(n_channels - 1, 1). The normative pseudocode is wrong and could cause spec-compliant implementations to produce invalid channel numbers.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed select_channel formula from MAX(NChannels, 3) to MAX(NChannels - 1, 2) to prevent out-of-range channel numbers. Updated spec pseudocode, Python implementation, and test vectors.
